items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Because Louis Russell told me I should haven't written the piano solo.

ctx.x: And I made it for him. But I made a mistake by writing out the piano part, by writing the piano solo. Because Louis Russell told me I should haven't written the piano solo. I don't know why. Well, I just wanted the solo to go that way.
